evidence: Plan artifact drafted at docs/delivery/plans/issue-227-dotnet-mcp-adapter-foundation.md; it remains documentation-only in the proposal stage.

Current official SDK research: ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore 2.2.0 targets .NET 8.0 or higher, was released 2026-08-13, maps Streamable HTTP using MapMcp, and supports the 2026-07-28 protocol while retaining down-level compatibility.
Design proposes an in-process host with a separately enforceable DomusMind.Mcp project boundary, empty production capabilities, test-only dispatch probe, and explicit Origin-security tests.
